invariants.rationale: The returned Stream should not be null, as all standard Stream operations produce non-null Streams.
The method invokes flatMapToPairFunc, so it must be non-null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
reduceFunc is wrapped and applied, so it must be non-null.
parallelism is likely used in a context expecting a positive value; using non-positive parallelism for partitioning is generally not meaningful.
data is used to obtain an iterator; a null data argument would result in error.
